output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is added to the balanceOf[target] without a check, allowing the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user's account to any value.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the balanceOf[_to] + _value is greater than balanceOf[_to], allowing users to overflow the balance of a target user, and exploit it to achieve overflow of user funds.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the balanceOf[_to] + _value is greater than balanceOf[_to], allowing users to overflow the balance of a target user, and exploit it to achieve overflow of user funds.
The buy function has a wrong logic vulnerability. The buyPrice is a public variable, attackers can manipulate it to cause unexpected buy prices, and attackers can steal funds from the contract.
The sell function has a wrong logic vulnerability. The sell function does not check if the amount is 0, attackers can exploit it to sell 0 tokens, and attackers can steal funds from the contract.
